notice: SYNTHETIC EVALUATION FIXTURES (held-out set). Every product, person, figure and quote below is invented for testing. None of it is market evidence and none of it may be cited as a source.
labelling: Written and labelled from docs/evidence_rubric.md after the first benchmark run on evidence_cases.json and before any change to the assessment prompt was evaluated, so that changes motivated by the first 40 cases are checked on cases they were not tuned on. Labelled by the VentureLab developers with an AI coding assistant (Claude), which is not the model under test (Qwen3). Labels are not changed after seeing model output.

cases.claim: The habit-tracker app's yearly plan costs 30 dollars.
cases.quote: The yearly plan costs 30 dollars and includes all features.
cases.context: Plans. The monthly plan is 4 dollars. The yearly plan costs 30 dollars and includes all features.
cases.rationale: The app's own plan page states the price.

cases.claim: At least one Shopify store owner says setting up abandoned-cart emails took them many hours.
cases.quote: Setting up abandoned-cart emails took me most of a weekend.
cases.context: I run a Shopify store selling sticker packs. Setting up abandoned-cart emails took me most of a weekend.
cases.rationale: One store owner, first person; most of a weekend is many hours.

cases.claim: Graphic designers across Europe struggle to get paid on time.
cases.quote: Two of my last five clients paid more than 60 days late.
cases.context: I'm a graphic designer based in Lisbon. Two of my last five clients paid more than 60 days late.
cases.rationale: One designer's experience, not designers across Europe.

cases.claim: Students will pay for the exam-flashcard app.
cases.quote: My whole study group uses the free version every day before exams.
cases.context: My whole study group uses the free version every day before exams.
cases.rationale: Shows use of the free version, not payment.

cases.claim: The note-taking app reduces meeting time.
cases.quote: The app syncs notes across phone and desktop.
cases.context: Features. The app syncs notes across phone and desktop. Notes can be shared by link.
cases.rationale: A feature, no evidence about meeting time.

cases.quote: I translate mostly legal and technical documents
cases.context: About me. I translate mostly legal and technical documents from German into English.
cases.rationale: About the work, nothing about billing preferences.

cases.claim: The browser extension works in Firefox.
cases.quote: The extension is available for Chrome and Edge only.
cases.context: Install. The extension is available for Chrome and Edge only.
cases.rationale: Only Chrome and Edge, so not Firefox.

cases.claim: Most beta testers rated onboarding as easy.
cases.quote: Of 50 beta testers, 32 rated onboarding as difficult or very difficult.
cases.context: Beta results. Of 50 beta testers, 32 rated onboarding as difficult or very difficult.

cases.claim: Music teachers need online scheduling tools.
cases.quote: Parking is free after 6 pm on weekdays.
cases.context: Visitor information. Parking is free after 6 pm on weekdays.

cases.quote: Our office will be closed for the public holiday on Monday.
cases.context: Notice. Our office will be closed for the public holiday on Monday.

cases.claim: The founder says the product has reached profitability.
cases.context: Investors often ask whether the product has reached profitability. Not yet; we expect to break even next year.
cases.rationale: The phrase is part of a question, and the founder answers not yet.

cases.claim: The reviewer found the course worth its price.
cases.quote: The course would be worth its price
cases.context: The course would be worth its price if the videos were updated, but most lessons use a version of the software from 2019. I would not buy it again.
cases.rationale: Conditional praise, and the reviewer would not buy it again.

cases.claim: Small cafes struggle to manage loyalty programmes.
cases.quote: Loyalty programmes are common in the cafe industry.
cases.context: Industry glossary. Loyalty programmes are common in the cafe industry.
cases.rationale: Says programmes are common, nothing about struggling.

cases.claim: Freelance photographers lose income because of slow photo delivery.
cases.quote: This post lists ten photo-delivery platforms for photographers
cases.context: This post lists ten photo-delivery platforms for photographers, with their storage limits.
cases.rationale: A list of platforms, no evidence of lost income.

cases.claim: Restaurants want an AI menu-translation tool.
cases.quote: MenuLingo launched an AI menu-translation tool last month.
cases.context: Product news. MenuLingo launched an AI menu-translation tool last month.
cases.rationale: A product launch is not evidence of what restaurants want.

cases.context: MenuLingo translates menus into 30 languages and charges per menu.
cases.rationale: A claim about the competitor itself, from its own description.
